visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a round, plastic-sealed bowl of '越式牛肉河粉' (Vietnamese Beef Pho) in front of a refrigerated supermarket shelf stocked with various packaged meals. The lighting is bright and industrial. The bowl's label features red and green branding from 7-Eleven with images of the dish. (2) Indoors, a man with a short, modern haircut and a white t-shirt sits at a dark desk. He holds a small, clear plastic sauce packet, tearing it and pouring a yellowish liquid into the open bowl of steaming pho. The background is a plain, warm-toned wall with a hint of a sofa. (3) The man uses white plastic chopsticks and a large white spoon to eat. He first sips the clear soup, then slurps the white rice noodles and a piece of brown beef. His facial expressions are highly animated, ranging from anticipation to pleasant surprise. The room lighting is soft and warm. (4) The man lifts the entire black plastic bowl to his face, tilting it back to drink the remaining soup with audible enthusiasm. He then lowers the bowl to show it is empty, smiling widely at the camera and pointing his chopsticks. Bright subtitles and graphic icons appear on screen.
